definition: Kling AI is a generative artificial intelligence service created and hosted by the Beijing-based technology company Kuaishou.
details: Kling generates videos from natural language descriptions, called prompts.
story: Think of a jazz musician who has heard so many solos that a new one simply falls out of their fingers. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. Creation, here, is memory recombined at speed. And that is Kling AI — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
